text.description_html:
Emtek 5123HLO, Hercules Key in Lever with Modern Rectangular Rosette

The Keyed Hercules Lever with Modern Rectangular Rosette is available in two functions: a keyed entry--where a key operates the latch from the exterior--and a dummy key in lever--which does not latch nor lock. The Hercules Key in Lever with Rectangular Rose will fit doors with 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets that are 1-1/4 inches to 2-3/4 inches thick. This modern keyed leverset is a great way to add extra security to your residential doors--making it the perfect chic way to lock your office or closet. It uses a Schlage C keyway, so it can be keyed alike to your matching Single Cylinder Rectangular Deadbolt so you only need one key to access your entire home.

Features and Specifications for the Emtek Rectangular Rosette with Hercules Lever:

  • Lever Length: 4-3/4"
  • Lever Projection: 2"
  • Rose Height: 4-3/8"
  • Rose Width: 2-5/8"
  • Doors Thickness: 1-1/4" - 2-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Keyway: Schlage C
  • Will fit standard 2-1/8" door preparations.

Available Functions

  • Keyed Entry (Keyed Lock): Use when a keyed lock is needed. The lock is operated by a key from the exterior and a thumbturn on the lever from the interior. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, keys, door latch, and strike plate.
  • Dummy: Trim for non-working doors. It does not latch and does not lock. Usually used as matching trim for the non-working side of double doors.

Levers are Handed. Handing Guide
